</style><style data-tailwind-stylesheet="true"></style><p>Optimizely Recommendations is a suite of cloud-based products, combining machine learning, artificial intelligence, and statistical analysis.</p>
<p>The Recommendations suite includes the following features:</p>
<ul>
<li><a target="_self" href="https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/commerce/v14.0.0-commerce-cloud/docs/recommendations">Optimizely Product Recommendations </a></li>
<li>Optimizely Email Product Recommendations</li>
<li>(Legacy) Optimizely Personalized Search & Navigation</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="get-started"></div><div class="heading-text">Get started</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Get started" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#get-started"></a></h2>
<p>Recommendations is based on a back-end service, tracking, and user interface components added to the website, and configuration keys for service access. As part of onboarding, Optimizely sends the required scripts, configuration keys, and credentials to the technical contact for your project. Use the keys to configure tracking for your websites. <a target="_self" href="mailto:managedservices@episerver.com" title="Contact Optimizely">Contact Optimizely</a> for questions about the onboarding process.</p>
<p>See also <a target="_self" href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/categories/4422145622413">Recommendations</a> for information about how to work with these features.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="product-email-and-search-recommendations"></div><div class="heading-text">Product, email, and search recommendations</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Product, email, and search recommendations" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#product-email-and-search-recommendations"></a></h2>
<p><strong>Optimizely Product Recommendations</strong> uses a tracking component, a core recommendations system, and general or product-specific integrations. The Recommendations system has a recommendation service that is fed with visitor tracking data from Optimizely Customized Commerce for product recommendations, and <strong>Optimizely Search & Navigation</strong> (legacy) for personalized search results. The recommendations engine processes visitor data and predicts intent.</p>
<p><strong>Optimizely Email Product Recommendations</strong> can trigger personalized emails based on visitors' website actions. You can store tracking data in <strong>Optimizely Profile Store</strong> (Customer Data Platform), or any other source. <strong>Optimizely Visitor Intelligence</strong> lets you visualize and analyze profile data, and create segments for targeted campaigns.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/0f7a3f1-Personalization-Tracking1.png" title="Personalization-Tracking1.png" width="auto"></span></span>
<p>To get the personalized recommendations running for a site, configure access to the <a target="_self" href="https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/personalization/v1.3.0-tracking/docs">tracking API</a>, so you can post usage data and get recommendations back.</p>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="integration-method-options"></div><div class="heading-text">Integration method options</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Integration method options" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#integration-method-options"></a></h3>
<p>Integration method options let you connect with the tracking service. See <a target="_self" href="/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/integration-guides">Integration guides</a>.</p>
<ul>
<li>Native integrations are specific for the <em>Optimizely product platform</em>.</li>
<li>Server-to-Server and JavaScript integrations are <em>general</em> recommendations system integration methods.
<ul>
<li><a target="_self" href="/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/native-integrations">Native integrations</a></li>
<li><a target="_self" href="/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/server-to-server-api">Server-to-Server API</a></li>
<li><a target="_self" href="/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/javascript-api">JavaScript API</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="heading heading-4 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="native-integrations"></div><div class="heading-text">Native integrations</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Native integrations" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#native-integrations"></a></h4>
<p>Native integrations let Optimizely products access the core Server-to-Server API for managing JSON tracking data and JSON-formatted content. Use native integrations for the Optimizely platform to simplify implementation of basic tracking and the product catalog feed. See <a target="_self" href="/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/native-integrations">Native integrations</a>.</p>
<h4 class="heading heading-4 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="server-to-server-integration"></div><div class="heading-text">Server-to-server integration</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Server-to-server integration" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#server-to-server-integration"></a></h4>
<p>The Server-to-Server API lets you integrate any website or application with products in the Optimizely Recommendations suite. In response to the tracking data sent, recommendations are returned with the Server-to-Server API response payload, based on JSON tracking data and JSON-formatted content. See <a target="_self" href="/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/server-to-server-api">Server-to-Server API</a>.</p>
<h4 class="heading heading-4 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="javascript-integration"></div><div class="heading-text">JavaScript integration</div><a aria-label="Skip link to JavaScript integration" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#javascript-integration"></a></h4>
<p>The JavaScript integration method uses JSON-based page tracking and product recommendations to provide flexible control for tracking visitor interaction, and designing the recommendation appearance. See <a target="_self" href="/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/javascript-api">JavaScript API</a>.</p>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="display-recommendations-in-widgets"></div><div class="heading-text">Display recommendations in widgets</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Display recommendations in widgets" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#display-recommendations-in-widgets"></a></h3>
<p>A widget is a block that displays recommendations, either on a web page or in an email message. A widget provides an automated way to add recommendations based on visitor interaction and other visitors' purchasing behavior. The recommendations are configured in the strategy defined for each widget, and are calculated by specific algorithms based on visitor tracking data.</p>
<p>During onboarding and Recommendations implementation, Optimizely works with you to define KPIs and recommendation strategies, and customize algorithms based on those strategies. Optimizely sets up widgets for the <em>home</em> and <em>product</em> pages, and recommendations are automatically served based on these default configurations. You can override this default "product strategy" manually from the Recommendations Portal, by using "hand-picked" strategies.</p>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="implement-product-recommendations"></div><div class="heading-text">Implement product recommendations</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Implement product recommendations" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#implement-product-recommendations"></a></h3>
<p>The Optimizely Recommendations suite is based on a service, and a set of NuGet packages that provide access to the APIs.</p>
<p>The service onboarding and solution setup typically involves these steps:</p>
<ul>
<li>Analyze requirements, <strong>define recommendation strategy</strong> and <strong>integration</strong> method.</li>
<li><strong>Install and configure</strong> service and components, set up test environment.</li>
<li><strong>Export product catalog feed</strong>, review and adjust.</li>
<li>Implement <strong>tracking</strong>, create content types, templates, and widgets.</li>
<li>Work with conversion data and merchandising rules in the Recommendations Portal.</li>
<li>Deploy, test and adjust the setup.</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="key-integration-components"></div><div class="heading-text">Key integration components</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Key integration components" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#key-integration-components"></a></h3>
<p>Recommendations has key components that you should not alter. If you need to alter the following components, co-ordinate with Optimizely.</p>
<h4 class="heading heading-4 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="user-tracking"></div><div class="heading-text"><strong>User tracking</strong></div><a aria-label="Skip link to [object Object]" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#user-tracking"></a></h4>
<p>Changes to user tracking needs can result in loss of behavior and core functionality, such as if you switched from tracking plain email addresses to pseudonymized user IDs or vice versa.</p>
<p><strong>Recommendations</strong> – To prevent user behavior from being lost, send Optimizely an up-to-date mapping between email addresses and pseudonymized user IDs. This needs to be provided only once so that Optimizely Recommendations can replace existing customer email addresses with their corresponding pseudonymized user ID.</p>
<p><strong>Mail</strong> – Continually provide your ESP (Email Service Provider) with an up-to-date mapping between email addresses and pseudonymized user IDs. Your ESP needs to create a new placeholder (mail merge variable) that represents the pseudonymized user ID. You then replace the email address placeholder from all your Mail campaigns with this new placeholder.</p>
<p><strong>Triggers</strong> – Your ESP must handle pseudonymized user IDs. Currently, in Triggers, this functionality is provided only by Optimizely Campaign. Alternatively, you need to advise your ESP to provide an API extension that lets Optimizely call methods that accept the pseudonymized user ID instead of email address. Also, provide and maintain a mapping between pseudonymized user ID and customer email address that your ESP can use to lookup, to send the email to the appropriate customer based on their pseudonymized user ID.</p>
<p>(Legacy) <strong>Promote</strong> – If provided, Optimizely Recommendations can use the visitor's IP address, within their session, to do a geolocation lookup to identify the approximate location of the visitor for a personalized online experience. IP addresses, if provided, are not stored, so cannot be used for analytics and reporting.</p>
<p>When you provide and test a user mapping, coordinate with Optimizely to schedule a deployment and receive further instructions.</p>
<h4 class="heading heading-4 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="product-reference"></div><div class="heading-text"><strong>Product reference</strong></div><a aria-label="Skip link to [object Object]" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#product-reference"></a></h4>
<p>The product reference (<button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">productId</span></code>) serves as an important connector between your data and the Optimizely recommendations engine; changes to this identifier break a connection between collected behavior and your product catalog. To prevent this connection from breaking, inform Optimizely of any plans to change the format of product references in your feed and tracking implementation. Provide a mapping from the old to the new product references and coordinate a deployment with Optimizely.</p>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="install-recommendations"></div><div class="heading-text">Install recommendations</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Install recommendations" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#install-recommendations"></a></h3>
<p>See <a target="_self" href="/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/install-and-configure-personalization">Install and configure recommendations</a> to install and configure the NuGet packages needed to access the API, and start working with personalized recommendations.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="cookie-usage-in-product-recommendations"></div><div class="heading-text">Cookie usage in Product Recommendations</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Cookie usage in Product Recommendations" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#cookie-usage-in-product-recommendations"></a></h2>
<p><strong>Optimizely Product Recommendations</strong> uses the following cookies in <em>standalone</em> implementations. For the <em>native integrations</em>, cookies are implemented in the native integration components for Optimizely Commerce.</p>
<p>Standalone Product Recommendations use cookies to keep track of visitors and their sessions. In <a target="_self" href="/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/integration-guides">standard and JSON integration</a>, Product Recommendations  /tracker/tracker.page HTTP request manages the cookies. In <a target="_self" href="/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/server-to-server-api">Server-to-Server API</a>, it is the client site responsibility to manage cookies, and the implementation is indifferent to Product Recommendations.</p>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="standard-and-json-integration-cookies"></div><div class="heading-text">Standard and JSON integration cookies</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Standard and JSON integration cookies" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#standard-and-json-integration-cookies"></a></h3>
<ul>
<li><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">peerius_user</span></code> – Required. Contains the customer user ID (CUID) of the visitor in Product Recommendations. Generated by Product Recommendations if not present. Valid indefinitely by default, but you can contact Optimizely Support to change the expiration time.</li>
<li><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">peerius_sess</span></code> – Required. Contains the visitor's tracking session ID. Valid for four hours since last visitor activity. Generated by Product Recommendations if not present or expired.</li>
<li><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">peerius_rid</span></code> – Tracks recommendations clicked by visitors. Managed by Product Recommendations.</li>
<li><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">peerius_stat_optout</span></code> – If set by the client, Product Recommendations does not track current visitor behavior.</li>
<li><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">peerius_ct</span></code> – Used internally by Product Recommendations to detect if the visitor disables cookies, or if the browser does not support cookies. Valid for two seconds.</li>
<li><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">peerius_pass_{paramName}</span></code> – Optional mechanism to pass parameters between Product Recommendations requests. Rarely used. Valid for one hour or until next Product Recommendations request.</li>
<li><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">viewedPeeriusPopUpModal</span></code> – Optional mechanism to track Promote (legacy) impressions in pop-ups.</li>
<li><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">do_not_track</span></code> – Mechanism to disable tracking for visitors that do not give tracking consent. Activated by client's site by providing any HTML element with ID equal to <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">episerverDoNotTrackOption</span></code>.</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="native-integration-cookies"></div><div class="heading-text">Native integration cookies</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Native integration cookies" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#native-integration-cookies"></a></h3>

Product Recommendations                                                           

For AI agents: visit https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/llms.txt for an index of all pages formatted in Markdown and endpoints in OpenAPI.

Optimizely Recommendations is a suite of cloud-based products, combining machine learning, artificial intelligence, and statistical analysis.

The Recommendations suite includes the following features:

*   [Optimizely Product Recommendations](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/commerce/v14.0.0-commerce-cloud/docs/recommendations)
*   Optimizely Email Product Recommendations
*   (Legacy) Optimizely Personalized Search & Navigation

## 

Get started

[](#get-started)

Recommendations is based on a back-end service, tracking, and user interface components added to the website, and configuration keys for service access. As part of onboarding, Optimizely sends the required scripts, configuration keys, and credentials to the technical contact for your project. Use the keys to configure tracking for your websites. [Contact Optimizely](mailto:managedservices@episerver.com "Contact Optimizely") for questions about the onboarding process.

See also [Recommendations](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/categories/4422145622413) for information about how to work with these features.

## 

Product, email, and search recommendations

[](#product-email-and-search-recommendations)

**Optimizely Product Recommendations** uses a tracking component, a core recommendations system, and general or product-specific integrations. The Recommendations system has a recommendation service that is fed with visitor tracking data from Optimizely Customized Commerce for product recommendations, and **Optimizely Search & Navigation** (legacy) for personalized search results. The recommendations engine processes visitor data and predicts intent.

**Optimizely Email Product Recommendations** can trigger personalized emails based on visitors' website actions. You can store tracking data in **Optimizely Profile Store** (Customer Data Platform), or any other source. **Optimizely Visitor Intelligence** lets you visualize and analyze profile data, and create segments for targeted campaigns.

![](https://files.readme.io/0f7a3f1-Personalization-Tracking1.png "Personalization-Tracking1.png")

To get the personalized recommendations running for a site, configure access to the [tracking API](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/personalization/v1.3.0-tracking/docs), so you can post usage data and get recommendations back.

### 

Integration method options

[](#integration-method-options)

Integration method options let you connect with the tracking service. See [Integration guides](/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/integration-guides).

*   Native integrations are specific for the _Optimizely product platform_.
*   Server-to-Server and JavaScript integrations are _general_ recommendations system integration methods.
    *   [Native integrations](/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/native-integrations)
    *   [Server-to-Server API](/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/server-to-server-api)
    *   [JavaScript API](/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/javascript-api)

#### 

Native integrations

[](#native-integrations)

Native integrations let Optimizely products access the core Server-to-Server API for managing JSON tracking data and JSON-formatted content. Use native integrations for the Optimizely platform to simplify implementation of basic tracking and the product catalog feed. See [Native integrations](/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/native-integrations).

#### 

Server-to-server integration

[](#server-to-server-integration)

The Server-to-Server API lets you integrate any website or application with products in the Optimizely Recommendations suite. In response to the tracking data sent, recommendations are returned with the Server-to-Server API response payload, based on JSON tracking data and JSON-formatted content. See [Server-to-Server API](/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/server-to-server-api).

#### 

JavaScript integration

[](#javascript-integration)

The JavaScript integration method uses JSON-based page tracking and product recommendations to provide flexible control for tracking visitor interaction, and designing the recommendation appearance. See [JavaScript API](/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/javascript-api).

### 

Display recommendations in widgets

[](#display-recommendations-in-widgets)

A widget is a block that displays recommendations, either on a web page or in an email message. A widget provides an automated way to add recommendations based on visitor interaction and other visitors' purchasing behavior. The recommendations are configured in the strategy defined for each widget, and are calculated by specific algorithms based on visitor tracking data.

During onboarding and Recommendations implementation, Optimizely works with you to define KPIs and recommendation strategies, and customize algorithms based on those strategies. Optimizely sets up widgets for the _home_ and _product_ pages, and recommendations are automatically served based on these default configurations. You can override this default "product strategy" manually from the Recommendations Portal, by using "hand-picked" strategies.

### 

Implement product recommendations

[](#implement-product-recommendations)

The Optimizely Recommendations suite is based on a service, and a set of NuGet packages that provide access to the APIs.

The service onboarding and solution setup typically involves these steps:

*   Analyze requirements, **define recommendation strategy** and **integration** method.
*   **Install and configure** service and components, set up test environment.
*   **Export product catalog feed**, review and adjust.
*   Implement **tracking**, create content types, templates, and widgets.
*   Work with conversion data and merchandising rules in the Recommendations Portal.
*   Deploy, test and adjust the setup.

### 

Key integration components

[](#key-integration-components)

Recommendations has key components that you should not alter. If you need to alter the following components, co-ordinate with Optimizely.

#### 

**User tracking**

[](#user-tracking)

Changes to user tracking needs can result in loss of behavior and core functionality, such as if you switched from tracking plain email addresses to pseudonymized user IDs or vice versa.

**Recommendations** – To prevent user behavior from being lost, send Optimizely an up-to-date mapping between email addresses and pseudonymized user IDs. This needs to be provided only once so that Optimizely Recommendations can replace existing customer email addresses with their corresponding pseudonymized user ID.

**Mail** – Continually provide your ESP (Email Service Provider) with an up-to-date mapping between email addresses and pseudonymized user IDs. Your ESP needs to create a new placeholder (mail merge variable) that represents the pseudonymized user ID. You then replace the email address placeholder from all your Mail campaigns with this new placeholder.

**Triggers** – Your ESP must handle pseudonymized user IDs. Currently, in Triggers, this functionality is provided only by Optimizely Campaign. Alternatively, you need to advise your ESP to provide an API extension that lets Optimizely call methods that accept the pseudonymized user ID instead of email address. Also, provide and maintain a mapping between pseudonymized user ID and customer email address that your ESP can use to lookup, to send the email to the appropriate customer based on their pseudonymized user ID.

(Legacy) **Promote** – If provided, Optimizely Recommendations can use the visitor's IP address, within their session, to do a geolocation lookup to identify the approximate location of the visitor for a personalized online experience. IP addresses, if provided, are not stored, so cannot be used for analytics and reporting.

When you provide and test a user mapping, coordinate with Optimizely to schedule a deployment and receive further instructions.

#### 

**Product reference**

[](#product-reference)

The product reference (`productId`) serves as an important connector between your data and the Optimizely recommendations engine; changes to this identifier break a connection between collected behavior and your product catalog. To prevent this connection from breaking, inform Optimizely of any plans to change the format of product references in your feed and tracking implementation. Provide a mapping from the old to the new product references and coordinate a deployment with Optimizely.

### 

Install recommendations

[](#install-recommendations)

See [Install and configure recommendations](/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/install-and-configure-personalization) to install and configure the NuGet packages needed to access the API, and start working with personalized recommendations.

## 

Cookie usage in Product Recommendations

[](#cookie-usage-in-product-recommendations)

**Optimizely Product Recommendations** uses the following cookies in _standalone_ implementations. For the _native integrations_, cookies are implemented in the native integration components for Optimizely Commerce.

Standalone Product Recommendations use cookies to keep track of visitors and their sessions. In [standard and JSON integration](/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/integration-guides), Product Recommendations  /tracker/tracker.page HTTP request manages the cookies. In [Server-to-Server API](/recommendations/v1.1.0-product-recommendations/docs/server-to-server-api), it is the client site responsibility to manage cookies, and the implementation is indifferent to Product Recommendations.

### 

Standard and JSON integration cookies

[](#standard-and-json-integration-cookies)

*   `peerius_user` – Required. Contains the customer user ID (CUID) of the visitor in Product Recommendations. Generated by Product Recommendations if not present. Valid indefinitely by default, but you can contact Optimizely Support to change the expiration time.
*   `peerius_sess` – Required. Contains the visitor's tracking session ID. Valid for four hours since last visitor activity. Generated by Product Recommendations if not present or expired.
*   `peerius_rid` – Tracks recommendations clicked by visitors. Managed by Product Recommendations.
*   `peerius_stat_optout` – If set by the client, Product Recommendations does not track current visitor behavior.
*   `peerius_ct` – Used internally by Product Recommendations to detect if the visitor disables cookies, or if the browser does not support cookies. Valid for two seconds.
*   `peerius_pass_{paramName}` – Optional mechanism to pass parameters between Product Recommendations requests. Rarely used. Valid for one hour or until next Product Recommendations request.
*   `viewedPeeriusPopUpModal` – Optional mechanism to track Promote (legacy) impressions in pop-ups.
*   `do_not_track` – Mechanism to disable tracking for visitors that do not give tracking consent. Activated by client's site by providing any HTML element with ID equal to `episerverDoNotTrackOption`.

### 

Native integration cookies

[](#native-integration-cookies)

*   `epi_RecommendationsTrackingSessionId` – Required. Contains the visitor's tracking session ID. Valid for four hours since last visitor activity. Generated by Product Recommendations if not present or expired.
*   `epi_RecommendationsTrackingUserId` – Required. Contains the customer user ID (CUID) of the visitor in Product Recommendations. Generated by Product Recommendations if not present. Valid indefinitely by default, but you can contact Optimizely Support to change the expiration time.
